title: ToolCallEvent
description: Payload of the analysis.toolCall notification: one observable moment in a live run, pushed from host to renderer as it happens. Where analysis.progress carries the model's own sentence about what it is doing, this carries the mechanical traffic underneath it — which tool, with what arguments, for how long, and what came back, plus the model's own reasoning and reply text as it produces them. The two notification methods stay separate — this is the ordered feed of everything the model did and said, analysis.progress remains the one-line status a reviewer glances at. One flat record with a discriminator rather than a family of shapes, because the contract generator cannot render a definition that references another definition.

sequence.description: One-based and increasing within a run. Notifications carry no ordering guarantee worth relying on, so the renderer appends in sequence order and ignores anything it has already seen.

kind.description: What happened. A tool_started and its tool_finished share a turn and a tool name, in that order. assistant_message carries the model's own reasoning and/or reply text for the turn, in responseText/reasoningText.

turn.description: Which round trip to the provider this belongs to, from 1.

toolName.description: The tool being called. Set on tool_started and tool_finished, absent otherwise.

argumentsPreview.description: The arguments the model passed, truncated. Set on tool_started. A preview rather than the whole thing: a model can pass a long regular expression or a fifty-path list, and the live view wants the shape of the call, not its every byte.

resultPreview.description: The beginning of what the tool returned, truncated. Set on tool_finished. Tool results are capped at 48 KiB each and a run may make five hundred calls, so the full text is deliberately not pushed across the bridge or retained; resultBytes says how much there was.

resultBytes.description: Size of the full result in UTF-8 bytes. Set on tool_finished.

durationMs.description: How long the call took, in milliseconds. Set on tool_finished.

isError.description: True when the tool refused or failed. A failed tool call is a result the model corrects, not a failed run, so this is information rather than an alarm.

inputTokens.description: Running total of input tokens for the whole run, carried on every event so the view never has to accumulate.

outputTokens.description: Running total of output tokens for the whole run.

costUsd.description: Running estimated cost in US dollars. Absent when the model has no entry in the price table — unknown is reported as unknown, never as zero.

contextTokens.description: How much of the context window the last request occupied, in the provider's own input-token count. Not the same number as inputTokens, which is the running total for the whole run: this one rises and falls as tool results are pruned. Absent until a request has reported usage, and absent for a provider that reports none — never defaulted to zero.

contextWindowTokens.description: The model's context window, from the profile's override or the bundled model table. Absent when neither knows the model, in which case contextTokens is shown as an absolute count with no percentage rather than measured against a guess. Carried on the event so the renderer needs no second lookup. Informational: no run is ever stopped for exceeding it.

contextInstructionsCharacters.description: Characters of system instructions currently in the transcript. Set on the same events as contextTokens. The breakdown is counted in characters rather than tokens because the application can count characters exactly and can only estimate tokens, and an estimate presented beside the provider's exact total would be read as the same kind of number.

contextSchemaCharacters.description: Characters of the response schema sent with every request, including the copy embedded in the prompt when structured output degraded to a prompted tier.

contextToolDefinitionCharacters.description: Characters of the tool definitions — names, descriptions and parameter schemas — sent with every request.

contextOpeningCharacters.description: Characters of everything the application has said as the user: the opening message — the changed-file list, the project profile and the reviewer's instructions — plus any correction it asked for afterwards.

contextToolResultCharacters.description: Characters of tool results still in the transcript. The only category that is ever pruned.

contextPrunedCharacters.description: Characters of tool results pruned from the transcript so far, counted cumulatively. Not part of the context any more; reported so a reader can see what retention is holding back rather than only what it kept.

contextAssistantCharacters.description: Characters the model has written that are still in the transcript: its text and the arguments of its tool calls.

contextReasoningCharacters.description: Characters of reasoning content the transcript carries separately from the model's text. Absent when the provider does not surface reasoning as its own content — which is not the same as the model having done none, and is shown as unreported rather than as zero.

retryDelayMs.description: How long before the next attempt. Set on retry.

retryAttempt.description: Which attempt is about to be made, from 1. Set on retry.

reasonCode.description: Why a retry was scheduled or a turn failed, as a stable code the renderer translates. Never prose.

atUtc.description: UTC instant the event was raised. Present on every kind, unlike analysis.progress's atUtc which is produced by the model's own report_progress call — this one is stamped by the host as the event is observed.

responseText.description: Set on assistant_message: the model's own reply text produced this turn, in full — not a preview. Absent on the turn that submits a structured final answer, where this would be the answer document itself; see ToolCallEvent's description.

reasoningText.description: Set on assistant_message: the reasoning content the response carried this turn, in full. Absent when the provider surfaced no reasoning this turn.
